limitations: No new neural training or GPU execution.
No nonlinear MI claim from isolated packet snapshots.
Periodic-domain evidence throughT4; no whole-line decay, global existence, physical free-surface validation or measured NOAA comparison.
u is a potential envelope with amplitude and phase, not actual surface elevation.
All max|u| observations are sampled grid maxima, with independent spatial refinement.
